design_philosophy: Sparse terminal objective combined with mild dense shaping for progress and fuel efficiency.
objective_signal: Terminal reward of +100.0 for safe landing, -100.0 for crash or out-of-bounds termination.
progress_feedback: Mild negative shaping on distance to pad (x,y), orientation error (angle), and velocity magnitude to guide descent without creating local optima.
regularizers: Linear fuel penalty (-0.1 per unit power) to discourage hovering and encourage efficiency.
diagnostics: Step-level metrics for fuel, position, velocity, and angle stored in individual_reward for analysis.

scale_reasoning.terminal_success: +100.0 (Dominant signal ensures task completion is prioritized)
scale_reasoning.terminal_failure: -100.0 (Strong deterrent against crashing or drifting out of bounds)
scale_reasoning.fuel_penalty: -0.1 * power (Small enough to allow necessary thrust, large enough to penalize waste)
scale_reasoning.shaping_terms: -0.5 * error (Subordinate to terminal reward, prevents agent from optimizing only for immediate proximity without landing)

constraints_adherence: No external side effects or helper methods used.
Avoids dense penalty dominance by keeping shaping weights low.
